prompt:
Production Unity enemy Rusher animation sheet. Input reference is exact silhouette, proportions and view, not a frame to duplicate. Redraw the same creature with articulated animated poses. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray tendon limbs, subtle amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D, elevated 45deg camera fixed, soft upper-left light. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front. FOUR limbs, single head; no sacs, no flower organs. Preserve the reference's blade-backed charging predator silhouette.
Direction MUST remain REAR view facing straight away toward TOP center, rear legs nearest viewer, back armor dominates, no front-facing eye slit; every pose is strictly back view, never turn. throughout all frames. Front limbs/head point toward top, hind limbs nearest bottom in rear views. When doing a slam, keep HIND feet nearest viewer braced on ground; raise the FRONT feet far from viewer.
FOUR COLUMNS, 7 ROWS, exactly 28 full creatures, PORTRAIT image width:height=4:7. Generous 20% transparent space around each sprite within its cell. Never overlap/touch any adjacent frame. Same body scale and foot anchor each frame. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real articulated four-leg gait, alternating diagonal pairs, lifted feet and planted feet, stable torso. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breath poses, feet planted. Row4: FOUR WINDUP frames: progressively brace hind legs, lower spear head, draw torso backward ready to charge; last frame fully braced. Rows5-6: EIGHT sequential CHARGE SPRINT frames, head lowered and armor forward, vigorous alternating reach/push leg motions, body stays at the same scale and ground anchor. Row7: FOUR DEATH frames: limbs buckle, spear head and plates settle on floor, eyes darken, collapsed corpse, no explosion.
Four consistent limbs, one head, same armor layout. No duplicate stills, no rotation-only simulation. Fully transparent background alpha0 and clean transparent gaps between legs. No floor or cast shadows, no text/labels/grid, no particles, no projectile.
